classification: restricted candidate-universe reconstruction, not verified deadline snapshots

sources.membership: players observed in the current or an earlier archived gameweek row
sources.scheduled_price: value in the archived gameweek fixture row; exact capture time is not documented
sources.blank_price: last observed archived value carried forward
sources.position: gameweek row where present, otherwise season-end players_raw.csv
sources.schedule: season-final fixtures.csv; may contain postponement/rescheduling hindsight

limitations: Players never observed before a blank gameweek cannot be reconstructed for that deadline.
Transfers or price changes during a blank gameweek may be carried forward incorrectly.
The archive does not verify status, can_select, or the fixture schedule as known at each deadline.
